text:
maria: Heads-up — customer X asked for a Private deployment in Q3. Need to confirm runtime/infra/security gaps before we commit to the roadmap. @jordan @suzanne @deepak can we align quickly? TL;DR: expected 2x latency SLO, HSM for keys, dedicated or burst capacity for pilot.

jordan: Should be doable but need model size + peak RPS. Also burst profile and seq length.

maria: From sales: model ~13B (we'll quantize), typical seq 1024, peak 200 qps sustained, ~1k burst for short windows. Customer wants a canary in staging week 1 of Q3.

suzanne: For Dedicated we can reserve a GPU pool but that requires a monthly commit. Net/VPC peering + firewall rules for customer account take ~3 weeks. Ops: do we plan prewarm?

deepak: HSM integration has extra steps — attestation + KMS mapping. We also need data residency confirmation (region). Security review required before canary.

kai: Routing/canary idea: fallback to smaller model variant if latency degrades. Canary plan should be 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks.

jordan: Runtime changes: KV cache prefill and a batching cap to hit latency SLO for large seqs. I can ship the batching cap change in 2 sprints if prioritized. Perf tests needed.

maria: Prioritization: product can promote this to P0 for Q3 if eng + infra can meet timeline. Can we commit to: patched runtime + burst/dedicated pool + HSM path by week 1 of Q3? If not, what's feasible?

suzanne: Realistic infra timeline: peering + firewall + provisioning = ~4 weeks end-to-end. If we use burst capacity for pilot we can avoid long procurement.

deepak: HSM attestation + mapping = ~3 weeks in parallel with infra. Need a security review slot — can we have one next Tue?

jordan: Trade: if we scope pilot to a 7B model instead of 13B, runtime changes drop to 1 sprint and perf risk lowers. Downsides: worse quality/latency for customer but faster launch.

maria: Decision proposal: Pilot on 7B using burst capacity and the staged canary. Action items: @jordan owner for batching cap & perf tests (due in 2w); @suzanne owner for burst pool request + peering (due in 3w); @deepak owner for security review + HSM plan (review next Tue); @kai owner for canary rollout doc + rollback triggers (due EOD Fri). I'll update the roadmap and comms. Any objections?

kai: Ack. I'll include rollback triggers: 99th percentile latency > 500ms OR error rate > 1% for 5m. Also add automated rollback step in rollout doc.

jordan: Ack. I'll add a perf-run snippet to the PR: ```python
# perf runner
rps = 200
seq = 1024
def run_load(rps, seq):
    pass  # placeholder for our test harness
```

maria: Thanks team :thumbsup:

(threads like this will feed the Q3 roadmap doc; I'll surface blockers to leadership if any of the owners hit scope/timeline risks)
